hero.title: An Enrolled Agent who can stand with you before the IRS
hero.lead: I'm Jessica Allyn, an Enrolled Agent preparing returns for individuals, business owners and tax-exempt organizations in Mont Belvieu and within 30 miles of Houston.

highlights.title: Monday through Sunday, 8am–6pm
highlights.text: Tax preparation is available 8am to 6pm, Monday through Sunday.

highlights.title: Enrolled Agent
highlights.text: Licensed to practice before the Internal Revenue Service.

highlights.title: Free introductory call
highlights.text: We start with a conversation about your situation, with no documents needed yet.

steps.title: Schedule a brief call
steps.text: We talk through your situation, timeline and filing needs, and you don't need all your documents ready.

steps.title: Receive a fee quote and engagement letter
steps.text: I send a fee quote and an engagement letter outlining the scope of work, and work begins once it's signed.

steps.title: Upload documents securely
steps.text: Once engaged, you get access to encrypted ShareFile to upload your tax documents rather than emailing them.

steps.title: Review, pay and file
steps.text: I prepare and review your return, and once the remaining balance is received I e-file it and provide your copy through Client Portal Access.

owner.name: Jessica Allyn

about.title: Tax preparation and compliance has been my work since 2019
text: I have worked in tax preparation and compliance since 2019, helping individuals and business owners with accurate filings, prior-year returns, and more complex tax situations.
I help individuals and business owners with accurate filings, prior-year returns and more complex tax situations.
As an Enrolled Agent, I'm a federally authorized tax professional who can prepare returns and represent taxpayers before the IRS, and I can e-file federal and applicable state returns.
